title: wkdoctor: SDK environment health check
desc: flutter-doctor-style health check for wkappbot-sdk environment
steps: USAGE: wkdoctor [-Json] -- flutter-doctor style [+]/[x]/[!] output, exit 1 on failures
LOCATION: bin/wkdoctor.ps1 + bin/wkdoctor.cmd in SDK repo

CHECKS (10): wkappbot.exe presence+version, wkappbot-core.exe, a11y.exe (warn), Eye tick ctx%, dotnet 8 SDK, skills catalog count, nightly-guard in ~/.claude/settings.json, bin/ in PATH, .wkappbot/config.json, wkappbot.hq/ dir
FLAGS: -Json for machine-readable output (ConvertTo-Json), exit 0=all pass, exit 1=any fail
RUN: wkdoctor  OR  wkdoctor -Json (pipe to ConvertFrom-Json for parsed output)
SETUP CHECK: run after fresh clone + setup.ps1 to verify environment is healthy
ROBUSTNESS: all checks use file/process/PE-version APIs only -- zero wkappbot subprocess calls (avoids Eye IPC stall in subprocess context)

ARCHITECTURE: wkdoctor.ps1 is a thin orchestrator; check logic lives in bin/wkappbot.hq/doctor/*.ps1 plugins (01-binaries, 02-runtime, 03-skills, 04-config, 05-hq). Each module calls Add-Check/Emit from orchestrator scope. No wkappbot subprocess calls -- uses PE VersionInfo + Get-Process + file count for robustness in any execution context.

PLUGIN STATUS: 5 modules written (01-binaries, 02-runtime, 03-skills, 04-config, 05-hq). Orchestrator rewritten as thin dot-source loader. All wkappbot subprocess calls removed. Opus healing review pending.
